title: Review an API refactor for regressions
request: Review this proposed refactor and identify compatibility regressions. Existing callers use `result = client.fetch(id)`, catch `NotFoundError`, and read `result.payload`. The proposal changes `fetch` to `async def fetch`, raises `KeyError`, and returns the raw payload dictionary. Explain the migration/testing needs. Do not execute tools or request a different workflow/resource.
